messages:
Nina: Hi @Ruth — starting Eli next Wed. Can you drop a tiny manager-first-week packet + a concrete 30/60/90 I can paste into the offer and calendar? Need measurable goals and who-to-ask links.

Ruth: Yup — keeping it compact. Do you want role-specific (serving/runtime) or generic eng?

Nina: Role-specific please (runtime). Also assign a buddy.

Ruth: Cool. Assigning Jun as buddy. Posting copy/paste plan below.

Ruth: ```
First-week packet (calendar copy):
Day -1: 1Password + SSO invite, Slack + email, hardware shipping confirm
Day 0: 15m welcome, meet buddy (Jun), product + infra 45m
Day 1: Local dev + repo walk (pair with Jun, 2h), access check (model store, logs)
Day 2: Onboarding-safe issue (label: first-timers), CI flow walkthrough
Day 3: Observability/tracing demo 30m, small metric/doc task assigned
Day 4: Ship first PR to staging, 1:1 recap & 30/60/90 finalization

Manager quick checklist (week 1):
- Post intro in #company + #eng-runtime (include pronouns + fun fact)
- Calendar: product, infra, observability demos + weekly 1:1s for 6 weeks
- Assign buddy & schedule pairing slots
- Create onboarding-safe issue and pre-assign reviewers
- Ensure security training queued and SSO/MFA done

30/60/90 (runtime, copyable):
- 30d: Env + access complete; 1 merged PR fixing a minor infra bug or doc (AC: CI green, reviewer sign-off, staging deploy)
- 60d: Own a small component and ship measurable improvement (AC: metric delta >=5% or alert reduction)
- 90d: Lead a rollout of an optimization and be primary on an oncall rotation (AC: runbook updated, post-rollout review, no P0 regressions in 2w)
```

Ruth: Who-to-ask quick list: IT Support (hardware/VPN), eng-infra (dedicated GPU quotas — ticket prefix onboard-gpu), Security (KMS/HSM access — onboard-kms), eng-sre (oncall/runbook). OnboardingBot handles training reminders.

SecurityBot: Reminder scheduled — Security Foundations to DM Eli on day 1; Data Handling on day 8. Targets: basic by EOD day 3, full by day 14.

Eli: Thanks! Laptop tracker shows "label created" — ETA? Also where are starter issues?

IT Support: Hi Eli — carrier delay, ETA 24-48h. DM preferred delivery window if urgent. Starter issues: https://git.redwood.ai/onboarding/labels/first-timers (pinned in #eng-runtime).

Jun (Buddy): Eli — I'll DM you a Day 1 pairing slot and a 30-min repo tour. I'll add two safe starter PRs to the onboarding board and a tiny checklist for local setup.

Nina: I'll schedule the 30-day retro and weekly 1:1s. Also drafting the intro blurb: "Eli joins as Runtime Engineer focusing on serving latency and cost. Fun fact: collects vintage synth pedals. Welcome Eli!"

Ruth: Posted intro in #company and pinned onboarding links in #eng-runtime. Sent fillable 30/60/90 to Nina and Eli. If any access blocks, prefix tickets with "onboard-urgent" and tag IT Support + eng-infra.

Eli: Great — thanks team. One last Q: who approves short-term Dedicated GPU access for experiments?

Ruth: Raise eng-infra ticket with prefix onboard-gpu and CC Nina. Default fast-track: 1 GPU for 30 days if approved.

IT Support: Noted — will update hardware tracking and DM when shipped.

Nina: Looks good — thanks @Ruth. Will post calendar invites and add acceptance criteria to each goal. Excited to have Eli onboard. :tada:
